title: Long-Range Non-reciprocal Ising Model

contributions.purpose: 引入长程非互易Ising模型并证明长程耦合在二维稳定swap相
contributions.evaluation: 100×100格:σ=1.0出现稳健swap相(L>0),σ=3.0完全抑制;短程模型2D无swap相
contributions.domain: 非平衡统计物理/时间晶体
contributions.source_quote: We introduce a long-range, non-reciprocal Ising model and demonstrate through large-scale simulations that long-range couplings are a crucial mechanism for stabilizing a spatio-temporally ordered "swap phase" in two dimensions—a regime where the equivalent short-range model is unstable.

contributions.purpose: 证明swap相是稳健时间晶体
contributions.mechanism: 多尺寸L∈{20..80}测磁化自相关提取相干时间
contributions.evaluation: 相干时间幂律发散 τc∝L^1.95(拟合z=1.95,理论z=d=2)
contributions.source_quote: We show that this phase behaves as a robust time crystal, with a temporal coherence that diverges with system size L as a power law, τc∝L^1.95.

contributions.purpose: 刻画无序→swap相的连续相变
contributions.mechanism: 有限尺寸标度(Binder cumulant交点+data collapse)
contributions.evaluation: 连续相变,临界点 eJc=1.94±0.01;临界指数极反常
contributions.source_quote: we use finite-size scaling analysis to rigorously characterize the transition from a disordered state into the swap phase, finding it to be a continuous phase transition with a precisely located critical point, confirmed by an excellent data collapse.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our research builds upon the foundational Ising model, a cornerstone for understanding equilibrium phase transitions (Ising, 1925). The canonical model... has been extended in two critical directions.

Our work directly addresses the gap at the intersection of these two areas, providing a bridge between the well-established fields of long-range equilibrium systems and the modern physics of active, non-reciprocal matter.

notes: 数据红旗(严重数字矛盾):正文data collapse临界指数写ν≈3.0、β/ν≈0.015,但图4d标题写Jc=1.943、ν=−5.78、β/ν=0.024(ν负值非物理),两处互斥。图错标:图3c标题"Coherence Time vs System Size (σ=3.0)"与正文"deep within the swap phase (σ=1.0)"矛盾(swap相在σ=3.0不存在)。幻影/模板引用:参考文献前3条[1][2][3](Alexander&Mozer模板规则抽取、Bower&Beeman GENESIS、Hasselmo海马)为NeurIPS模板占位文献未删;Dyson1969、Plischke重复列出。checklist指令说明块两处未删("Delete this instruction block"仍在)。可复现红旗:平均run用np.random.seed(int(time.time()*1000))时间戳播种却声称有error bar。checklist AI披露:假设[D](AI提全部假设)、实验[C]、分析[D]、写作[C];Broader impacts答[NA]"no negative societal impacts"。轻微:τc∝L^1.95自称与z=2"excellent agreement"。
